name: Launch Shield
summary: Time-boxed limits on routed execution while a market is being activated.
behavior: Per-wallet cooldown between routed buys (optionally sells).
Maximum routed buy and sell size during the protected window.
Maximum routed buys per slot; optional denial of same-slot buy→sell round trips.
Window starts at market activation or a fixed timestamp and lasts at most 30 days.
verification: source in this repository; reproducible-build verification not yet published
limitations: Applies to trades routed through Pump Hooks only. A transaction that trades on Pump directly is not affected.
